column1: NATIONAL GEOCHEMICAL SURVEY OF AUSTRALIA: THE MERCURY CONCENTRATIONS DATASET

CITE AS: Schneider; L.; Taylor; J.R.; Caritat; P. de 2025. National Geochemical Survey of Australia: The Mercury Concentrations Dataset. Geoscience Australia Dataset; Canberra. https://pid.geoscience.gov.au/dataset/ga/150328

NOTES: NGSA SITEIDs were numbered from 2007190001 to 2007191600 then randomly allocated to individual States or the Northern Territory. As some SITEIDs were reserved for insertion of QA/QC samples and only 86% of targeted sites were sampled gaps occur in the list of SITEIDs (e.g. no data for SITEID = 2007190006)
Geochemical data consist of total Hg concentrations. For more Methods details see Schneider et al. (2026) @ https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.est.5c11189
Extraction: Total Hg measured by direct analysis (no digestion) on approximately 100 mg of sample
Analysis: Milestone tri-cell direct mercury analyser (tri-cell DMA-80) reported in ng/g (= parts per billion; ppb) on dry weight basis with a Limit of Detection of 0.01 ng Hg

Additional geochemical data from the National Geochemical Survey of Australia available from http://dx.doi.org/10.11636/Record.2011.020; additional field site information available from http://pid.geoscience.gov.au/dataset/ga/70478
